scope: Offline folder-lock host, modifier and clearance isolation
findings: Host-only outline preserves the source shoulder and deliberate lower-right interruption. No independent curve snapping or new contour operation is needed for that shape.

Removing filled clearance causes lock body and shackle to disappear into folder ink. Existing selected cuts restore visible separation at both sizes. This is an occlusion/construction requirement, not an evidenced kernel representation gap.

The filled24 isolated shackle has one hole at thresholds64/128/192; filled16 loses that hole at64 and retains it at128/192. Local selected-composition shackle masks equal isolated modifier masks, but this does not establish adequate native16 counter robustness.
Whole-image topology mismatch against modifier-only is expected because full compositions add a folder; it is diagnostic, not a fidelity failure or acceptance score.
The24 selected composition has2components at64/128 and3at192; the16 composition changes from1component/2holes at64 to2components/1hole at128/192. Threshold sensitivity remains unresolved.
